messages:
Anika (Product): quick follow-up from today's all-hands — need clarity on Console rollout timeline for Optimize integration and the API changes (streaming + function-calls). multiple product teams asked about canary windows and migration path.

Owen (VP Product): short answers: Optimize Console beta canary -> 2026-06-02; GA target -> 2026-07-08. Hosted API v2 (streaming + function-calls) rolling to standard orgs in June. Dedicated will follow once infra validation completes (target late July). I'll post a timeline doc by EOD tomorrow.

Eli (Eng): can we agree on canary success criteria? suggest: 1) 99th latency regression <5% 2) overall error rate <0.1% 3) token cost delta <10% vs baseline. Also need perf runs for seq lengths 128/512.

Priya (Optimize PM): locking cohorts next week. plan: week1 pilot with 3 customers, week2 expand to 10, week3 wider beta. suggestions will be opt-in via flag `optimize.suggestions=true` initially. migration guide + example config will land in docs repo.

Jesse (Infra): Dedicated note: compatibility build required (runtime 1.12.0). customers on older pinned versions will need upgrade — we'll publish a one-command upgrade: `redwood upgrade runtime --to 1.12.0`. expect Dedicated rollout late July due to staging + certification.

Anika (Product): what's the GA gate and rollback plan? teams want concrete acceptance criteria and playbook.

Owen (VP Product): GA gates: beta customers must meet SLOs for 2 consecutive weeks; no open severity-1/2 regressions; docs and SDKs updated. rollback: per-route fallback to previous model variant + console toggle. Eng will maintain rollback runbook.

Priya (Optimize PM): action items: I'll share the canary cohort doc and invite customers — volunteers welcome. will also add a small eval harness for quality checks tied to our prompt set.

InfraBot: Deployment scheduled (auto): canary window 2026-06-02 09:00 UTC -> 2026-06-09 09:00 UTC. Notifying staging channels.

Eli (Eng): +1 on metrics, will run perf matrix next week and post results.

Anika (Product): thanks all — pls add owners to the timeline doc. @Eli @Jesse @Priya please drop short notes by EOD Fri. :thumbsup:

Owen (VP Product): will follow up with the timeline doc link once it's posted. :rocket:
